mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ebus_artifact (biz_id, user_id, run_id, artifact_type, scene_code, template_id, title, payload_json, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{bizId}, #{userId}, #{runId}, #{artifactType}, #{sceneCode}, #{templateId}, #{title}, #{payloadJson}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE ebus_artifact SET artifact_type = #{artifactType}, scene_code = #{sceneCode}, template_id = #{templateId}, title = #{title}, payload_json = #{payloadJson}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE biz_id = #{bizId}
